This page compares [MOIRE](../tutorials/moire/moire_background.Rmd) effective COI with the simulated effective COI. The simulated data are described in [Simulated datasets](../website_docs/data_simulated.qmd).

The parameter set is the one chosen for MOIRE on the [sample-level COI page](coi_sample.qmd).



## Full panel


::: {.cell}
::: {.cell-output-display}

:::
:::



::: {.cell}
::: {.cell-output-display}


Table: Lin's concordance, mean absolute error, and mean bias. Bias is the estimate minus the simulated effective COI.

|Tool  |Best parameter set | Lin's CCC|   MAE| Mean Bias| Samples|
|:-----|:------------------|---------:|-----:|---------:|-------:|
|MOIRE |moire_beta5_rel    |     0.711| 0.667|    -0.511|   32000|
